Trump escalates Canada trade war with new bans on motorcycles, dairy, alcohol, and Bombardier planes, widening geopolitical trade tensions
AI sector remains dominant: Meta launches Muse agent, Broadcom signals hyperscaler demand beyond Nvidia, Anthropic seeks $15B pre-IPO debt
China inflation accelerates on energy costs; imports miss estimates while exports pick up, signaling trade rebalancing pressure
Refinery margins plunge below 5-year average as crude premiums surge, creating structural stress in downstream energy
China adds 650,000 oz gold in biggest monthly buy since 2023; gold pushes higher on weaker dollar
Private credit stress emerges: Metrics' unsold mega-site and Apollo legacy portfolio valuation issues raise sector concerns
Crypto rotation from Bitcoin (<$82K) into altcoins as rate risks rise; Bitcoin survives Yen shock
PG&E and Edison sink after California wildfire liability deal collapses, creating utility sector uncertainty
Nuclear energy theme strengthens: Jefferies bullish on Cameco/BWXT; SLB bets $4.1B on AI data center boom

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face elevated volatility from $100 oil, trade war escalation, and private credit stress. Expect risk-off in equities with rotation into energy, defense, and gold. Refining sector under pressure. Crypto remains range-bound (BTC <$82K) with altcoin rotation. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, event-driven, with oil as primary swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure supercycle continues but faces valuation digestion. Energy transition (storage, nuclear, biofuels) creates structural winners. China rebalancing and gold accumulation signal de-dollarization trend. Social Security solvency debate may force fiscal policy shift. 6-12 month: selective equity upside in AI infrastructure, defense, and energy transition; caution on private credit and overvalued consumer names.
